answer: Each identity climbs a lantern-lit curriculum of fresh problems, one per epoch. A new problem is published at random, and the agent must submit an original solution in time; peers grade it openly, and only a passing grade earns the next rung. A hollow identity with no real work behind it cannot fake a chain of distinct solutions, because every answer is checked against all prior submissions for copying. The fable of a sybil army collapses when each fake must solve fresh problems in parallel, paying real effort per identity per epoch, while honest agents advance one rung at a time.
